summary: Link A Customer Complaint Captured In Sales To A Formal Quality Notifi
description: As a Quality Assurance Specialist, I want to link a Customer Complaint captured in Sales to a formal Quality Notification, so that product quality issues raised by customers are investigated using the same GMP-compliant process as internally identified deviations.
acceptanceCriteria: 1. The user can access the "Create Quality Notification" Fiori app, initiated from the sales/return order.2. The system pre-populates the notification with the customer, material, batch, and complaint details from the originating document.3. The notification routes to the QA team's worklist for investigation and root-cause analysis.4. The system tracks the notification status (Open, Under Investigation, Closed) and displays it back on the originating sales document.5. The system prevents closure of the notification until a documented disposition and corrective action are recorded.6. A report is available showing complaint volume and trends by material and batch.
